questions.prompt: What does a Delta Lake transaction log help a table provide?

options.text: A record of table changes and transaction state
A guarantee that every query runs on a GPU
An automatic backup to a public website

questions.explanation: A transaction log records table changes and supports consistent table state.

questions.prompt: Which two practices can help make a data pipeline easier to operate?

options.text: Track pipeline failures and execution status
Delete all run history after each task

questions.explanation: Quality checks and run status help operators detect and diagnose issues.
